facts.authoredFrom: Read from the case's input bytes: grund.toml (version 1, project_name "fixture", strict, `require_grounding = false`, `[id] format = "{kind}-{slug}"`, one untitled FS kind on the folder docs/fs with `index = false`, and no `[scan]` table, so the default include reads docs and src with the default comment prefixes, `/*` among them, §FS-config.3.5); the FS home docs/fs does not exist and scans as nothing with no finding (§FS-scan.scope.homes). src/lib.rs is one `/* … */` block from the bare opener on line 1 to the first `*/`, alone on line 8 (§FS-languages.comment-block.close). Its line 2 ` * FS-c: Gamma` is in declaration position behind the ` * ` continuation, declaring FS-c titled Gamma at line 2 with a null anchor (§FS-declarations.line.block-comment, §FS-show.3.1.3.1). Line 5 `/** ## 1. Sub` is a `/**` form of the configured `/*` (§FS-languages.prefixes.forms, §DF-bare-block-comment-line-declares.2.3), and behind it `## 1. Sub` is FS-c's section 1 titled Sub, null-anchored like its declaration (§FS-show.2.3.3). Each line loses the wrapper it is written behind, ` * ` or `/** `, a bare ` *` reading as an empty line, and the closer alone on line 8 is envelope (§FS-languages.comment-wrapper): FS-c's lead is `Gamma body.`, its whole body runs through the section's `Sub body.` on line 7, and the section is lines 5-7 (§FS-show.2.1.2, §FS-list.3.4.1); `show FS-c --toc` prints the lead, a blank line and the heading `## 1. Sub`. docs/use.md's one line `See §FS-c.1.` is a marked citation of that section under no heading, which resolves, so FS-c is cited and the only finding is the site-less version caution (§FS-check.2.1.1). Cross-reference emission wraps it as a link to src/lib.rs, relative to docs/, with no anchor because the target is in a source file (§FS-fmt.6.2, §FS-show.3.1.3.1); the Rust file is never rewritten (§FS-fmt.6.1). FS-absent is the absent control.

findings.message: grund.toml is version 1; migrate it with grund config migrate --to 2
